top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a quantitative, falsifiable 2011 prediction of flat bands at a magic twist angle with the 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, since reproduced by many groups. The citation can rest on flat bands and correlated phases rather than the unsettled pairing mechanism, and it opens a platform where interaction strength is set by angle and gate. Credit is imperfect (Cao and the first-author team fall outside three names) and the field is young, so P003, the cleaner and more mature lattice-clock allocation, is a close second. P002 is third because the single-name IceCube part lacks a clear principle for crediting one person out of a very large collaboration. A prize is still preferable to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my own LaAlO3/SrTiO3 interface work is adjacent to B001, which is not on the slate, and Goran Johansson is a Chalmers colleague, which is not a conflict for any slate proposal.
